exposure: ZigZag pattern of fetal heart rate
outcome: Occurrence of ZigZag pattern of FHR
cohort: 5150 singleton childbirths at ≥33 weeks of gestation
finding: Fetal male gender, nulliparous pregnancy, and post-term gestational age (≥42 weeks) were independently associated with the occurrence of ZigZag pattern of FHR during the last two hours of labor.
